Simply Houses mod compromised with Fracturiser malware

Target: Simply Houses
Repository: N/A
Date: 2023-05-01 to 2023-06-08 (38 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Game mod
Language: Java
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive:
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration
User Impact:
Domain: curseforge.com (package host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

A developer account (`shyandlostboy81`) with publishing rights for the 'Simply Houses' Minecraft mod on CurseForge was compromised. Attackers uploaded a malicious JAR file disguised as a legitimate update. This file contained the 'Fracturiser' malware, designed to steal credentials (Discord, Microsoft, Minecraft) and spread to other JAR files on the user's system.
